544:t_2:421.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I told you not to move.」

544:t_2:424.en:
$$かなめ$$
「It's your fault! I told you and told you not to come!」

544:t_2:425.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You killed this girl! What are you going to do about it!?」

544:t_2:427.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$千鳥$$...! You're only temporarily mentally disturbed! That's why I'm going to...」

544:t_2:433.en:
$$宗介$$
(Why did it have to end like this...? $$千鳥$$...)

544:t_2:437.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I'll definitely be waiting for you, so don't worry...)

544:t_2:444.en:
$n
「I saw her run out of here. Captain $$テスタロッサ$$ has fainted, but she's safe.」

544:t_2:445.en:
$$宗介$$
「No way...! I'm sure I saw $$テッサ$$ get shot dead...!」

544:t_2:446.en:
$$宗介$$
「And before that, why am I even alive!?」

544:t_2:448.en:
$$宗介$$
「Was that... one of the possibilities $$千鳥$$ showed me...?」

544:t_2:449.en:
$n
「Anyway, we're getting out of here. The $$クロノ$$ Reformists are trying to destroy this facility.」

544:t_2:451.en:
$$宗介$$
($$千鳥$$... Your voice that reached me in the darkness of death... your feelings...)

544:t_2:452.en:
$$宗介$$
(If you're waiting for me, I'll surely come to get you...!)

544:t_3:3.en:
$$かなめ$$
(...I think I understand very well what I've done...)

544:t_3:4.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I killed $$宗介$$, and I killed $$テッサ$$ too...)

544:t_3:5.en:
$$かなめ$$
(Poor things... Their deaths are painful and sad, but they're two people with no more use...)

544:t_3:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
(The shallow game of being friends and the game of tragic lovers are both over.)

544:t_3:7.en:
$$かなめ$$
(This world is going to be redone in the not-too-distant future anyway...)

544:t_3:8.en:
$$かなめ$$
(No matter what happens or who dies, I don't need to care... As long as I'm alive...)

544:t_3:9.en:
$$かなめ$$
(The mission $$ソフィア$$ entrusted to me... I'm the only person who can save this world...)

544:t_3:10.en:
$$かなめ$$
(That man surely foresaw this and brought me to $$ヤムスク１１$$... He must have prepared for what I should do next, too...)

544:t_3:11.en:
$$レナード$$
「Looks like you're finally awake.」

544:t_3:12.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Yeah. Sorry to keep you waiting.」

544:t_3:14.en:
$$レナード$$
「Almost. I've been working on it ever since we took down $$メリダ島$$.」

544:t_3:16.en:
$$レナード$$
「Anywhere you wish, my princess.」

544:t_3:17.en:
$$かなめ$$
「How kind of you. You're not going to be rough anymore?」

544:t_3:18.en:
$$レナード$$
「Because it's no longer necessary. Isn't that right?」

544:t_3:19.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Yes... I won't be selfish anymore.」

544:t_10:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Is there some jinx where good-natured, short-straw snipers die young...」

544:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Your will, Mr. $$クロウ$$, which made $$尸空#pilot$$ flinch even as you worried about Mr. $$クルツ$$, produced $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 100 Z...」

544:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

544:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「However, it feels as though a hole has opened in my own heart as well...」

544:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...The $$Ｄトレーダー$$ is open for business today, but congratulations to our ace pilot will have to wait for the next occasion.」

544:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Mr. $$クルツ$$... Our dirty-joke talks... I'll never forget them as long as I live.」

544:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「With a prayer for the repose of his soul, allow me to say it. Same as ever today... business, business.」

544:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The death of a good-natured sniper... That grief from back then... again...?」

545:t_000:0.en:
$$キャシー$$
「All units are in position.」

545:t_000:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「With this, the $$アマルガム$$ forces deployed in the area should go for us.」

545:t_000:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「And in the meantime, Captain $$テスタロッサ$$ and the others sneak into a place called $$ヤムスク１１$$, huh.」

545:t_000:3.en:
$$桂$$
「So what exactly is in those ruins?」

545:t_000:4.en:
$$マオ$$
「$$テッサ$$... Don't you think it's about time you explained things to us, too?」

545:t_000:5.en:
$$カレン$$
「Yeah, yeah. One commander who works us to the bone without explaining anything is plenty for me.」

545:t_000:7.en:
$$クルツ$$
「A lot of people hold a grudge against you, $$ゼロ$$.」

545:t_000:11.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...$$ヤムスク１１$$, where we're headed, is a research city facility the $$人革連$$ built in the past.」

545:t_000:13.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Over ten years before the $$ブリタニア・ユニオン$$'s 《$$プロメテウス・エクスペリメント$$》...」

545:t_000:14.en:
$$テッサ$$
「There, the first artificial $$時空震動$$ experiment by human hands in $$ＡＤＷ$$ history was carried out.」

545:t_000:16.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$アマルガム$$ is trying to develop a $$時空震動弾$$...」

545:t_000:17.en:
$$スザク$$
「So there may be a hint there for tracking their movements...」

545:t_000:18.en:
$$テッサ$$
(And the secret of $$カナメ$$ and us also lies sleeping there...)

545:t_000:19.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units will stay here and serve as a decoy to draw in $$アマルガム$$.」

545:t_000:20.en:
$$クルツ$$
「We don't intend to end up as mere decoys, sir.」

545:t_000:21.en:
$$クルツ$$
「After all, I'm in top form right now! I'm not afraid of anything!」

545:t_000:23.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「$$ウェーバー$$... Don't forget why you were allowed to act alone, understood?」

545:t_000:24.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Understood! Master Sergeant $$クルツ・ウェーバー$$ will make the operation he devised himself a success without fail!」
